title: #inc-2251: Private feeds a few minutes behind after replica lag

messages.text: [FIRING:1] FeedBuildLagHigh (namespace=feeds cluster=prod-eu-west severity=warning)

replies.text: this is private feeds only? seeing a new ep in public but not in a couple paid URLs
checking feeds_ro path now

messages.text: INC-2251 declared by @ne. Sev3. Private feeds a few minutes behind after replica lag.

replies.text: ty, gonna stay in this thread

messages.text: looking at pg-feeds lag graph, one replica is drifting up pretty steadily. not huge yet but not normal.

replies.text: yep, private-feeds is reading from feeds_ro and that replica is the one behind

messages.text: grafana link: https://grafana.castlane.internal/d/pg-feeds-replication?var-cluster=prod-eu-west the serving replica is already past 2 min behind

replies.text: yeah, seeing apply lag climb, not a network thing

messages.text: pulling psql on the replica to see what is open. if this is a long query holding replay back that would fit.

replies.text: can you check with a read-only session? don't want to poke it too much

messages.text:
```
select pid, usename, state, now() - query_start as age, left(query, 120)
from pg_stat_activity
where state <> 'idle'
order by query_start asc;
```

replies.text: got one analytics query at 00:06:xx age, still running. that smells like the blocker.

messages.text: yep, broad aggregation over recent activity. not on private-feeds code path, but it's on the same replica.

replies.text: that would explain why new eps are late but nothing is actually broken

messages.text: replica is keeping up on writes until vacuum/replay gets pinned. hot standby feedback is on here, so the long query is not getting kicked.

replies.text: ugh, ok

messages.text: checking who pointed the reporting job at this host. i thought it was supposed to use the spare replica.

replies.text: looks like the reporting config still has the serving replica in its target list

messages.text: lag just crossed 3 min on grafana. private feed URLs are definitely stale now.

replies.text: can confirm from a test pft_ URL, latest ep missing on first refresh, then shows up later

messages.text: i'm not loving the idea of killing the query if it's a reporting job, but moving it is the cleaner fix. there's a spare replica available.

replies.text: agree, don't want to whack a live report if we can just move it

messages.text: found the job: it was still using the old host alias. i'm changing it to the dedicated reporting replica now.

replies.text: good. once it reconnects, replay should catch up fast

messages.text: can you paste the exact change? want to make sure we don't leave the serving host in any fallback path.

replies.text: yeah, removing the serving replica from the job config entirely, not just changing primary host

messages.text: seeing the old session disappear and the new one land on the spare. lag is still high but should start dropping.

replies.text: nice

messages.text: lag graph just turned, down from 4m-ish to under 2m.

replies.text: good sign, feed refreshes should start catching up soon

messages.text: i'm watching replay rate, it's moving again. no sign of further pinning on the serving replica.

replies.text: cool, leave it alone unless it stalls

messages.text: reporting query is fully off the serving replica now. spare is taking it.

replies.text: ack

messages.text: private feed test URL is fresh on reload now. still a little behind on a couple shows but way better.

replies.text: same here, lag down to about 50s

messages.text: under 1 min now. that's basically the recovery point.

replies.text: good, let's keep watching for a few more mins

messages.text: steady under 20s on the serving replica. no new long queries on feeds_ro.

replies.text: nice, that should be back in the normal band

messages.text: all the sampled pft_ URLs I checked now show the latest episode immediately. support chatter seems to have stopped too.

replies.text: same. i'm done poking it

messages.text: lag is settled at single digits again. I don't see any residual backlog on the serving path.

replies.text: ok let's close it

messages.text: INC-2251 resolved by @ne. Duration 48m 59s.

replies.text: i'll keep the config change and update the ticket after
